key.name: enable-shader
key.description: Apply real-time GLSL chromatic split, scanline glitch and matrix sweep on workspace faces.

key.name: glitch-windows
key.description: Also apply the cyber-glitch shader to transitioning window clones while preserving 3D parallax.

key.name: enable-hud
key.description: Display a 60fps Cairo terminal packet stream, signal waveform, and node-lock banner during switches.

key.name: shader-intensity
key.description: Strength multiplier for glitch displacement and matrix overlays.

key.name: primary-color
key.description: Matrix green accent color for scanlines, rain, and HUD elements.

key.name: secondary-color
key.description: Chrollo purple accent color for brackets and split highlights.

key.name: alert-color
key.description: Crimson alert accent for active node lock and hex warnings.
